The '''Seltaya Major system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Mieru'kar sector/Legends|Mieru'kar sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Seltaya Major]].

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
While [[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']] placed the system in the Expansion Region, [[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']] mentioned a planet called Seltaya and placed it in the [[Mieru'kar sector/Legends|Mieru'kar sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. Both sources described Seltaya as an ice world and homebase to a group of pirates. This contradiction was solved with the publication of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] the Seltaya from ''Wanted by Cracken'' to be Seltaya Major in the Seltaya Major system and Seltaya from ''Twin Stars of Kira'' to be Seltaya Minor (or Ropagi III) in the [[Ropagi system/Legends|Ropagi system]].<ref name="Atlas" />
